units.source_text: 薰大将看看她的手笔，觉得虽然草草不工，却也颇有风趣，楚楚可观。

en.t: General Kaoru looked at her handwriting and thought that, although it was hasty and unpolished, it still had considerable charm and an elegant appeal.

units.source_text: 他不知道此人是谁，想必是正欲上皇后殿前去，

en.t: He did not know who this person was, but supposed she must have been on her way up to the Empress's chambers,

units.source_text: 被他遮断了路，暂时滞留在此的。

en.t: only to have her path blocked by him and be kept here for the moment.

units.source_text: 弁姐看了薰大将的诗，说道：“说得斩钉截铁，像是老翁口气，太没趣了。”

en.t: Lady Ben read General Kaoru's poem and said, "It speaks far too bluntly, like an old man's tone; it is terribly dull."
